solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Register includes unknown Hungarian composer

indicators.note: the register is said to hold something within it, so the other letter goes inside

parts.note: to register is to list, as on a roll
Z is a standard algebraic unknown, like X and Y

explanation.surface: A record book lists an anonymous composer from Hungary.
explanation.definitionFit: Franz Liszt was the celebrated nineteenth-century Hungarian pianist and composer.

clue.text: Room inside the French grill

indicators.note: the room is placed within the French article, enclosed by it

parts.note: LE is the French masculine form of the
an attic is a room in the roof space

explanation.surface: A French kitchen with a grill in its room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grill' suggests cooking; here it is a criss-cross grating.
explanation.definitionFit: A lattice is a framework of crossed strips, the same kind of grating as a grille over a window.

clue.text: Hard work disturbed Swede at party

indicators.note: something disturbed is jumbled out of place, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: Labour is one of the main UK political parties

explanation.surface: A Swedish guest at a party is upset by strenuous effort.
explanation.walkthrough: LABOUR is the British left-of-centre political party.
explanation.definitionFit: Sweated labour is gruelling work done for low pay in poor conditions, so it is heavy toil.

clue.text: Not entirely where studying at university may lead one

definitions.text: where studying at university may lead one
definitions.meaning: a student's course ends in a qualification, so the phrase can be read as heading toward a bachelor's award

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means somewhat or partially, while literally it describes a path that leads toward an academic qualification.

clue.text: Creeping plant in American's caravan

definitions.meaning: a plant that trails along the ground or over a wall
in US usage a mobile home or caravan is called by this name

explanation.surface: A creeper growing over a holiday van in the States.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: a trailing plant creeps along the ground, and Americans call a towed caravan by this word.

clue.text: Much younger lover in rhyme

parts.note: the phrase for a young male partner of an older woman is two short words that rhyme with each other

explanation.surface: A poem about a romance with a much younger partner.
explanation.definitionFit: The term is slang for a young man who is the lover of a considerably older woman, and its two halves rhyme.

clue.text: Help female servant male deserted

indicators.note: the male has abandoned the servant, so his letter leaves

parts.note: a maid is a female servant

explanation.surface: A maid is helped after her husband walked out.
explanation.definitionFit: Aid is assistance or support, a direct synonym of help as a noun or verb.

clue.text: Recreational complex has unusual line — rest cure to conserve energy!

indicators.note: to conserve something is to keep it safe within, so the energy letter is held inside
unusual means out of the ordinary, so these letters take an odd new order

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A spa promises a rest cure that will save your energy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusual' rearranges LINE and REST CURE together; 'to conserve' tucks E inside that mix.
explanation.definitionFit: A leisure centre is a public building with sports and recreation facilities such as pools and gyms.

clue.text: Part of official list announced

indicators.note: something announced is spoken out, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: a roll is an official list of names, such as an electoral roll

explanation.surface: A part on an official cast list is announced.
explanation.definitionFit: A role is an actor's part in a play, or a function someone performs.

clue.text: What psychoanalyst gives male during wild party?

indicators.note: the male pronoun comes in the middle of the party, inside it
a wild party is out of order, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: HE is the male pronoun

explanation.surface: A puzzled look at what a shrink offers a man at a raucous party.
explanation.definitionFit: Psychoanalysis is a form of treatment for the mind, so an analyst provides talking treatment to patients.

clue.text: Training doctor poorly

parts.note: poorly means unwell, ill

explanation.surface: A medic is too unwell to attend training.
explanation.definitionFit: Drill is repetitive practice or instruction, as soldiers train on the parade ground.

clue.text: Eventually entered for a marathon?

definitions.meaning: in the end, after a long time has passed
a runner signed up for a marathon is literally taking part in a lengthy race

explanation.surface: Someone finally signing up to run a marathon.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means ultimately or over time, while read literally it describes a competitor in a long-distance race.

clue.text: Happy, having stumped one former Prime Minister

parts.note: glad means happy
ST is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for stumped, a way of being out

explanation.surface: A cricketer is pleased at stumping a batsman who was once Prime Minister.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a batsman can be out stumped, written ST on the scorecard.
explanation.definitionFit: William Gladstone served four times as Liberal Prime Minister of the United Kingdom in the Victorian era.

clue.text: Finish university, about to go through

parts.note: to finish is to end
RE means about, concerning, as in business letters

explanation.surface: A student completing a degree and on the point of graduating.
explanation.definitionFit: To endure a hardship is to undergo or suffer it, which is to go through it.

clue.text: Stroke is worried about onset of storm

indicators.note: the worried word goes around the single letter, enclosing it

parts.note: someone who is worried cares, frets

indicators.note: the onset of something is its beginning, so the first letter is taken

explanation.surface: Someone has a stroke from anxiety as a storm approaches.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stroke' suggests a medical event; it is a gentle touch. 'about' puts S (the start of storm) inside CARES, before its last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A caress is a light, affectionate touch, so to stroke someone tenderly is the verb sense.

clue.text: Have doubts about group protecting American leader in Paris

indicators.note: the group surrounds and shields the other letters, holding them inside

parts.note: a sect is a group, especially a religious faction
US means American

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone doubts that a group is guarding a US politician in France.
explanation.definitionFit: To suspect something is to mistrust it or feel it may be untrue, so to harbour doubts.

clue.text: Somehow drew diamonds, holding ace and king

indicators.note: the outer letters grip the ace, keeping it inside
somehow means in some unspecified way, so the letters are arranged in another manner

parts.note: D is the card abbreviation for diamonds
A is the card abbreviation for ace

explanation.surface: A card player has drawn a diamond flush with the ace and king.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram signal rearranges DREW to EDWR; with D added, 'holding' places A inside, giving EDW-A-RD. 'king' seems a card but defines the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Eight English monarchs bore this name, from Edward I to Edward VIII, so it is a king's name.

clue.text: Shopkeepers had brass here in resort

indicators.note: letters put into a new sort are rearranged, so the phrase is shuffled

explanation.surface: Shop owners had their money in a seaside holiday town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' looks like a holiday town but reads as re-sort, the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Haberdashers are traders who sell sewing goods such as ribbons, buttons and thread.

clue.text: Report made by knight in case

indicators.note: the knight is placed within the case, enclosed by it

parts.note: a bag is a case for carrying things
N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: A report written by a knight is filed in a case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Report' looks like a document; it is a loud noise, as of a gun.
explanation.definitionFit: A report is the sound of an explosion or gunshot, a sudden loud noise.

clue.text: A bottom in the air

parts.note: the foot is the bottom of something, as the foot of a page or hill

explanation.surface: Someone upended with their backside raised high.
explanation.definitionFit: Something afoot is going on or in preparation, as a rumour or plan is said to be in the air.

clue.text: Eleven, maybe, not finishing this drink

indicators.note: not finishing means stopping short of the end, so the last letter is lost

parts.note: an eleven is a team, as in cricket or football

explanation.surface: At eleven, perhaps, a hot cup is left unfinished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Eleven' suggests an elevenses time; it is a side of eleven players.
explanation.definitionFit: Tea is the hot beverage brewed from leaves, a favourite British drink.

clue.text: Messenger's job to intercept porter

indicators.note: the job cuts into the porter, getting in its way and sitting inside it

parts.note: porter is a dark beer, a type of ale
a job is a post, a position of employment

explanation.surface: A courier is assigned to stop a doorman on his way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'porter' looks like a doorman; it is the dark beer, here ALE.
explanation.definitionFit: An apostle is one sent out to spread a teaching; the Greek root means one sent forth, an envoy.

clue.text: Most of clothes left with child star

indicators.note: most of a word is all but its last letter, so the end is dropped

parts.note: garb means clothing, dress
and means with, together with

explanation.surface: Most of the outfit was left with a young performer.
explanation.definitionFit: Judy Garland became famous as a child performer, starring as Dorothy in The Wizard of Oz at sixteen.

clue.text: Just ahead of time in competition

indicators.note: one piece placed ahead of the other comes before it in the answer

parts.note: just means fair, even-handed

explanation.surface: Someone arrives only just before the time for a contest.
explanation.definitionFit: An event is a single contest within a sports meeting, such as a race at the Olympics.
